 Korean Derma Skincare Brand MDP+ Launches at Nordstrom
 Peptide 9 Bio Sun Stick Pro and targeted neck care lead the brand's US department store debut. 
 November 8, 2026 
 By: Lianna Albrizio 
 Associate Editor , Happi 
 Save 
 Image caption -->
 MDP+, a Korean derma skincare brand, has marked its debut entry into the US department store channel with a launch at Nordstrom.
 The brand will launch on Nordstrom.com and roll out in phases to seven select Nordstrom stores, with broader availability through Nordstrom Rack stores nationwide and online. The launch builds on MDP+’s presence on Amazon , TikTok Shop and Olive Young Global.
 MDP+ will roll out in phases to the following Nordstrom locations: Downtown Seattle in Seattle, Wa.; Oakbrook Center in Oak Brook, Ill.; Mission Viejo and Arcadia, Ca; Frisco, Tx; Coral Gables, Fla; and Ala Moana Center in Honolulu, Hawaii.
 Product Assortment
 The Nordstrom assortment highlights MDP+’s signature Peptide 9 collection and targeted neck care products.
 The Peptide 9 Bio Sun Stick Pro is an SPF 50 sunscreen stick designed for easy, “mess-free” reapplication throughout the day, including over makeup. It has reportedly become a standout product for MDP+ in the US, with more than 450,000 units sold on TikTok Shop to date. The broader Peptide 9 collection features peptide-based formulas designed to support skin firmness and volume.
 The Neck Care collection includes the Collagen Naite Thread Neck Cream, known for its distinctive thread-like texture, and the Naite 1000 Shot Neck Stick. The assortment also features products from MDP+’s Red Lacto Collagen collection.
 An expanded eight-product assortment will be available on Nordstrom.com and through Nordstrom Rack, both in stores nationwide and online. Additional offerings include the Red Lacto Collagen Wrapping Mask; Red Lacto Collagen Clear Foam Cleanser; Red Lacto Collagen Cleansing Oil; Peptide 9 Volume & Tension Cream Pro; and Peptide 9 Volume Ampoule Pro.
